desc: Implement NTT for polynomial multiplication modulo 998244353.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N.
Compute digit length counts cnt[l] and weights w_l = 10^l mod MOD.
Build polynomial P_l(x) = (1 + w_l x)^{cnt[l]} using binomial coefficients.
Multiply all P_l to get F(x) truncated to degree N.
Compute S_w[l] (sum of numbers with l digits) and invC(N-1, m) for m=0..N-1.
For each length l, compute G_l array using recurrence, then sum_G = Σ G_l(m) * invC(N-1, m).
Accumulate answer as Σ S_w[l] * sum_G, multiply by (N-1)!.
